chunks: Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir narrated to us from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amir, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Sad ibn Turayf, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) would say in his prostration: I whisper to You, O my Master, just as a servile slave whispers to his master. I request from You as one who knows that You give without diminishing what is with You. I seek Your forgiveness as one who knows that none forgives sins except You. I rely upon You as one who knows that You have power over all things.

key_terms.توكل: Tawakkul - reliance upon God, entrusting one's affairs to Him
key_terms.قدير: Qadir - All-Powerful, capable of all things
key_terms.مناجاة: Munajat - intimate private supplication, whispering to God in devotion

ai.seo_question: What supplication did Imam Ali say during prostration?
ai.summary: This hadith records a beautiful supplication that Imam Ali (AS) would recite during prostration. It expresses four dimensions of worship: intimate munajat (whispering) with God likened to a humble slave before his master, requesting with confidence in God's inexhaustible bounty, seeking forgiveness with certainty that only God can forgive, and complete reliance (tawakkul) on God's omnipotence. The supplication was witnessed and transmitted by al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, one of Imam Ali's closest companions.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdillah b. `Amer from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Aban b. `Uthman from Sa`d b. Turayf from al-Asbagh b. Nubata. He said:

Amir al-Mu’minin (as) would say in his prostration: I whisper to You, My Master, just as a servile slave whispers to his master. I request from You whilst knowing that You give without decreasing what is with You. I repent to You whilst knowing that none forgive sins except You. I rely on You whilst knowing that You have power over all things.
